question: Alveolar ventilation is the volume of air that:

options.opa: It enters (or exits) the lungs in each breath.
options.opb: It enters (or exits) in the airways every minute.
options.opc: It remains in the alveoli after a normal expiration.
options.opd: Enter (or exit) in the lung exchange zones in one minute
options.ope: It remains in the alveoli after a forced expiration.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Alveolar ventilation -> volume of air entering or exiting the lungs in each breath -> 80% CHAIN: Alveolar ventilation -> volume of air entering or exiting the airways every minute -> 70% CHAIN: Alveolar ventilation -> volume of air remaining in the alveoli after a normal expiration -> 60% CHAIN: Alveolar ventilation -> volume of air entering or exiting the lung exchange zones in one minute -> 50% CHAIN: Alveolar ventilation -> volume of air remaining in the alveoli after a forced expiration -> 80%
